sourceFile: 25. TIU C11-20  Report test UV Led 3rd date 27.12.2025_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft identifies the UV LED 3rd test context but has unresolved condition grouping and erroneous measurement extraction.
issues: Changed factor combines reduced and increased UV settings, but outcomes only substantiate part of that comparison.
Baseline/test row pairing is unclear because multiple Normal and UV-setting rows are cited without subgroup keys.
Tension sample counts appear wrong; rows contain multiple sample values but draft reports sampleCount 1.
Measurement-2 misclassifies function-table columns as measurement statistics.
Some key cited rows are not shown in context, limiting verification of row-level evidence.
correctionPlan: Inspect rows 15-24 and map each row to Normal, reduced UV, or increased UV conditions.
Create separate subresults for reduced vs Normal and increased vs Normal only where row pairing is supported.
Preserve row keys such as No/date/type and any sample or lot identifiers.
Recalculate tension sample counts from actual measured values and keep min/max/avg citations.
Remove Measurement-2 or convert it into valid function defect metrics rather than measurement stats.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations exist but are not sufficient until hidden cited rows and grouping are verified.
